description: My name is Tracy Robins and I am running to represent SC House District 75 in the South Carolina General Assembly in the November 2026 General Election. Even though I lost my primary 2024 bid against former Representative Kirkman Finlay, I am eager to regain this seat for the Republican Party. I knew it would be a difficult task to defeat Finlay in the primary, but I did work extremely hard.
